channel.description: Monday through Friday get up to speed on the biggest headlines of the day with 5 Things. On Saturdays, get a break for your ears with good news from 5 Good Things. item.title: Trump’s Asia Tour Begins
item.description: President Donald Trump kicks off his Asia trip in the Philippines, signing trade papers with Thailand that stops short of a full deal. Meanwhile, Trump warns Iran would pay a major price if it carried out an attack on the nation’s capital. Several people are injured after severe turbulence on a flight headed to Florida. Massive attacks between Russia and Ukraine have damaged major bridges. Plus, Pizza Hut’s last surviving co-founder has died. Learn more about your ad choices. Visit podcastchoices.com/adchoices

item.title: Is the AI Bubble About to Burst?
item.description: President Donald Trump is responding to criticism over his handling of last week’s ground stop, which disrupted thousands of flights. The Commerce Department has taken a new step to prevent China from accessing sensitive AI chips. A suspect has been arrested in connection with an explosive device found at an ethanol plant in central Illinois last week. A former top financial regulator is warning that the AI boom could be headed for a bust. Plus, a new James Bond has been named. Learn more about your ad choices. Visit podcastchoices.com/adchoices
